name: Grizzly 74
description: 5.45x39 squad automatic on the AK pattern: a long heavy barrel and 45-round magazines. Takes AK-74 magazines, grips, stocks and muzzle devices.

name: Bulwark 249
description: Belt-fed 5.56x45 light machine gun. A hundred rounds in the box, and it takes STANAG magazines in a pinch.

name: Anvil PK
description: Belt-fed 7.62x54R general-purpose machine gun. Shreds cover, armor and anyone behind it.
